notes.title: V 1.3.9 patch notes
notes.notes: • Fixed broken Single Convoy missions in 1.3.7

notes.title: v 1.3.6 patch notes
notes.notes:
• Added mission area select screen for War Patrols
• Added option to show position info on custom chart markers
• Added option to show a line with distance measurement on custom chart markers
• Sonar pings can now be heard as long as you’re within detection range + 1km
• Added chance of a sub location taking permanent, irreparable damage (Hard/Sim only)
• Modding: Added adjustable Hit Points per sub location
• Modding: Added adjustable chance of crewman injury per location
• Fixed bug that could put enemy ships on land

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 patch notes
notes.notes:
• When you “Save As...” a Campaign patrol, it will now continue as a Campaign (not a standalone Patrol)
• When you “Save As…” or continue a custom-named game, auto-saves will continue to use that file.
• Add a Side Mission in the first 30 seconds of a patrol (to give new players an objective)
• Holding down fire button/key repeat-fires deck gun
• Only notify player & reset time scale if enemy torpedo will come within 300 yards
• Reduced strobing of radar sweep at high time scales
• Fixed bug where new side missions at bases close to player won’t activate
• Long-press of keyboard shortcuts for dive, ascend, and fire torpedoes now trigger long-press events for those actions
• Added keyboard shortcut to halt dive/ascend at current depth (default: “h”)
• Added keyboard shortcuts to dive/ascend by 1 foot (default: Ctrl-c/Ctrl-e)
